chunks.arabic_text: رِجَالُ الْكَشِّيِّ: عَنْ أَبِي طَالِبٍ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ الصَّلْتِ الْقُمِّيِّ قَالَ

translations.en: Rijal al-Kashshi: From Abi Talib Abdallah ibn al-Salt al-Qummi who said:

chunks.arabic_text: دَخَلْتُ عَلَى أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ الثَّانِي عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامِ فِي آخِرِ عُمُرِهِ فَسَمِعْتُهُ يَقُولُ: جَزَى اللَّهُ صَفْوَانَ بْنَ يَحْيَى وَمُحَمَّدَ بْنِ سِنَانٍ وَزَكَرِيَّا بْنَ آدَمَ عَنِّي خَيْرًا فَقَدْ وَفَوْا لِي وَلَمْ يَذْكُرْ سَعْدَ بْنَ سَعْدٍ، قَالَ: فَخَرَجْتُ فَلَقِيتُ مُوَفَّقًا، فَقُلْتُ لَهُ: إِنَّ مَوْلَايَ ذَكَرَ صَفْوَانَ وَمُحَمَّدَ بْنِ سِنَانٍ وَزَكَرِيَّا بْنَ آدَمَ وَجَزَاهُمْ خَيْرًا، وَلَمْ يَذْكُرْ سَعْدَ بْنَ سَعْدٍ، قَالَ: فَعَدْتُ إِلَيْهِ فَقَالَ: جَزَى اللَّهُ صَفْوَانَ بْنَ يَحْيَى وَمُحَمَّدَ بْنِ سِنَانٍ وَزَكَرِيَّا بْنَ آدَمَ وَسَعْدَ بْنَ سَعْدٍ عَنِّي خَيْرًا فَقَدْ وَفَوْا لِي

translations.en: I entered to see Abi Ja'far the Second (peace be upon him) towards the end of his life, and I heard him saying: 'May Allah grant a goodly recompense to Safwan ibn Yahya, Muhammad ibn Sinan, and Zakariyya ibn Adam on my behalf – for they have been loyal to me', but he did not mention Sa'd ibn Sa'd. He [Abu Talib] said: I left and encountered Muwaffaq, and I said to him: 'My master mentioned Safwan, Muhammad ibn Sinan, and Zakariyya ibn Adam, supplicating for their good, but he did not mention Sa'd ibn Sa'd.' He [Abu Talib] said: I returned to him [the Imam], and he said: 'May Allah grant a goodly recompense to Safwan ibn Yahya, Muhammad ibn Sinan, Zakariyya ibn Adam, and Sa'd ibn Sa'd on my behalf – for they have been loyal to me'.

en.summary: This narrative from Rijal al-Kashshi highlights the meticulous attention to detail in the Imams' recognition of their companions, illustrating that the initial omission of Sa'd ibn Sa'd was likely a moment of natural focus rather than neglect. The Imam’s prompt inclusion of Sa'd upon reminder underscores the Shia scholarly emphasis on the integrity and loyalty (wafa') of the rawis (narrators) who preserved the Ahl al-Bayt's teachings during the era of political pressure.
en.seo_question: Who were the loyal companions praised by Imam al-Jawad in this narration?

key_terms.مُوَفَّقٌ: Muwaffaq, a servant of the Imam
